title: review: B3: per-executor scorecard from runs + tasks; review verdict capture; `orchestrator scorecard`; Pool.scores()
spec:
Why: routing must adjust from live outcomes. Scout T-0013: status/rounds/merged_into/sha exist on task json; duration_s/tokens/usd/outcome in runs jsonl; missing: review verdict field, complexity in logs (B2 adds), any rollup by executor. Depends on B1 and B2 merged into goal/T-0005.

What (≤5 files: orchestrator/scorecard.py (new), orchestrator/cli.py, orchestrator/merge.py, orchestrator/spawn.py, tests/test_orchestrator.py):
1. orchestrator/scorecard.py — `def build(root=STATE) -> dict`: read runs/*.jsonl and tasks/T-*.json; key by executor id (run field `executor`, falling back to task["executor"] or f"claude:{tier}"); per executor: merged (tasks with merged_into), failed (status failed), held_usage_limit (runs outcome in usage_limit/rate_limit), rounds_avg (task rounds over done tasks), wall_s (sum duration_s), tokens {in, out, cache_read}, usd (sum), review_request_changes (tasks with review_verdict == "request_changes"), by_complexity {"1-3","4-6","7-10": {merged, failed}}. `def scores(card, min_runs=5) -> dict[str, float]`: success = merged/(merged+failed); score = 0.5 + success when runs ≥ min_runs else 1.0 (neutral); executors with ≥3 usage-limit hits today get ×0.5. `def write(card)` → STATE/scorecard.json with a `generated_at` ISO timestamp (Europe/Zurich offset is fine via datetime.now().astimezone()).
2. spawn.run_worker review path: parse `verdict` from the review result JSON and `bus.update(task_id, review_verdict=...)`; also for the reviewed task (inputs[0]) set review_verdict.
3. merge.merge: after a successful fast-forward call scorecard.write(scorecard.build()) inside try/except (never fail a merge on scorecard errors).
4. pool.py must NOT be edited here; instead `Pool.scores` is provided via a thin module-level function in scorecard.py that executor.py already looks up with getattr — so add in executor.start: `scores = scorecard.scores(scorecard.build())` guarded by try/except → {} (edit executor.py ONLY for that 3-line call; it is in scope for that reason). cli.py: `orchestrator scorecard [--by executor|tier] [--json]` prints a table (one line per executor: id merged failed rounds_avg wall_s usd hits score) or JSON.
5. tests: synthesize a runs jsonl and two task jsons under TMP (one merged, one failed, one usage_limit run) and assert build() counts and scores() (neutral below min_runs; below-1 for a failing executor when min_runs=1).

Run `uv run python -m unittest tests/test_orchestrator.py`. Commit: "scorecard: per-executor outcomes from runs+tasks, review verdict capture, scores() feed pick_executor, cli scorecard" with a revert-path body.
acceptance: uv run python -m unittest tests/test_orchestrator.py exits 0 with the new scorecard tests
uv run orchestrator scorecard prints one line per executor id present in runs/tasks (header + N lines) and --json is valid JSON
after a merge() .orchestrator/scorecard.json exists with generated_at
executor.start passes scores from the scorecard into pick_executor (test with min_runs=1 shows a failing executor scoring below 1.0)
git diff --stat limited to orchestrator/scorecard.py, orchestrator/cli.py, orchestrator/merge.py, orchestrator/spawn.py, orchestrator/executor.py, tests/test_orchestrator.py
